_comment: Paste this at api.slack.com/apps -> Create New App -> From a manifest, in your own workspace. Socket Mode is on, so the relay needs no public URL and no tunnel: it dials out to Slack. After installing, put the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-), the App-Level Token (xapp-, scope connections:write) and the Signing Secret into channels/.env. Never paste them anywhere else.

display_information.name: Curb Cut
display_information.description: Find out what could make work easier. Then decide whether to ask. Never in a channel, never sends from here.
display_information.long_description: Curb Cut is a workplace accessibility assistant whose principal is the worker, not the employer. In Slack it answers only in a direct message, tells you on first contact that Slack belongs to your employer and names the two channels that do not, and never drafts or sends a request from here. The send button lives on the web, where you are anonymous. Nothing you write is stored; your Slack user id is hashed before it touches any record.

slash_commands.description: Ask what could make work easier. Answers only you can see.
slash_commands.usage_hint: what is hard right now, in your own words
